analysis: Reviewed provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Config/ProviderConfig.swift: base lines 1-732 and head lines 1-520. The head excerpt is truncated, so head lines 521 onward and any later hunks were not seen. The only visible delta is a doc comment on engineV2MaxConcurrent (base 158-162, head 158-164). It says models on the native `auto` paged allowlist now start at concurrency 8 on M5 Pro/Max/Ultra via ServingPerformanceProfiles.automaticConcurrency. The executable config code in this file is unchanged: defaultEngineV2MaxConcurrent is still 4 (head 299), the Codable init and encode logic is unchanged (head 407-410, 461-463), and CodingKeys is unchanged. No new config keys, no change to parsing or validation (cache.validate() remains in ProviderConfig.init), and no change to coordinator URL, auth, attestation or key handling. The comment implies a concurrency policy change elsewhere (ServingPerformanceProfiles and the backend resolution/admission code), but that code was not supplied. Later passes should check that code for availability and memory-exhaustion risk (T-010, T-029, ADV-001/ADV-002 DoS). They should also check that higher batch width does not weaken prefix-cache (T-041), KV, or co-tenant isolation assumptions (T-028), and that effective caps stay bounded by physical-fit and shared-Mac admission, as the comment claims. This file gives no evidence of a security regression. A conclusion about the runtime change is limited by the missing source.
